about: Polestar's route fixes, read by every Forge build from this checkout (never built into forge): `deliberate` holds v1's deliberate orders, the player-report fixes every route cut keeps; `overrides` holds the maintainer's hard rules (include, skip, revert, pairs). Each entry says why (`why`, or `reason` and `issue`). Check an edit with `forge data check-corrections`; docs/forge/routes.md sections 5 and 11 describe every key. $POLESTAR_ROUTE_FIXES names another file.

deliberate.about: v1's deliberate orders (player-report fixes pinned by tests/guides-reported.test.js and the guides' 'Order changes against the export' headers) as hard precedence pairs: every step of `a` comes before every step of `b` when both are in the order. Kinds: accept, task (an objective site of the quest), turnin. `group`: {q, size, why}: the group an elite or group quest wants (1 soloable elite, 2-4 a group of that many, 5 never taken) where Forever's creature data reads it wrong; the route may take it with a solo fallback (docs/forge/routes.md, Group quests).
